crownPassive.name: Shepherd of the cave
crownPassive.text: Your front-rank cards have +2 Health and +1 Guard.

bond.name: Son of Poseidon
bond.text: +1 Attack while another Hellas hero of yours lives. While an enemy Trickster is on the board, -1 Attack instead.

actions.name: Attack
actions.text: Standard attack: damage equal to Attack.

actions.name: Hurl the boulder
actions.text: A Ranged attack for 4 on any enemy card. A hero it hits has -1 Speed next round. Once per fight.
